blocks.text: Check our Miss International 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson’s bid to the crown has begun as the 64th edition of Miss International officially opened in Tokyo, Japan, on Wednesday, Nov. 25. Seventy-three delegates from different countries and territories are vying for the Miss International 2026 title, currently held by Colombia’s Catalina Duque. The candidates took the stage in their elaborate national costumes to formally introduce themselves and the countries they represent.
